draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.24, the 72nd-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 5th of 14 at guard. He lasted until pick 114, well after his grade rank (72nd): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Carolina Panthers (practice squad). 34 career games and 14 starts over 3 completed seasons. Producing near his peak: 2 AV in 2025 against a career-best 2 in 2023. Weak spots: approximate value 2 (22nd percentile). Played 7 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-3 guard who played: 20.0% season snap share against a median of 40.7%, below the norm.
